review_comments: There were a couple of windows failures, I think we don't have enough granularity there to ensure that we capture some write load.

I am not sure I follow how that could happen just because of granularity. The test does not validate that there is a > 0 write load.

The assertion that failed seems to be for a null write load. AFAICS, that can only happen if we did not get a stats response from one of the shards. Which sounds strange in this test. Did I miss something obvious?
Right 🤦, I think that we allocate all shards into 2/3 nodes and then we don't get any stats back.
